card.name: Gl in glucose after blood terms
card.fires_on: The first piece "Gl" of the word glucose, mostly after "Fasting", "Serum", "Plasma" or "Blood" in lab-test and monitoring headings. The next piece is expected to be "ucose".

card.writes: It promotes "blood" words and suppresses carbohydrate and sugar words, so it steers away from other sugar terms.
card.plain: It fires on the start of the word glucose when it appears in blood sugar test phrases.
